call_points.text: FY26 volume growth was mid-single digits, with growth described as holistic across brands.
Neurobion and Livogen grew around 20%; Seven Seas early double digits; Nasivion and Evion high single digits.
Three FY26 launches contributed early single-digit points of growth to the overall business.
FY26 gross margin improvement came from productivity, favourable product mix and NPPA-permitted pricing.
Productivity programmes delivered ₹35 Cr of savings in FY26.
Exports grew in FY26 with 3X growth in Nepal and high single-digit growth in Sri Lanka.
Asked about Evion and Polybion declining in FY26 on IQVIA data, management gave no figure and pointed to doctor advocacy.
Management sees GLP-1 adoption as complementary, with VMS brands positioned alongside medical treatments.

timeline.summary: On its 18 June 2026 analyst call, P&G Health reported FY26 sales of close to ₹1,400 Cr (+16%) and PAT of ₹327 Cr (+30%), with mid-single-digit volume growth and ₹35 Cr of productivity savings, and gave no FY27 guidance.

watchlist.response: Management cited NPPA price-increase norms and said growth is holistic, without quantifying price or volume.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked for the FY26 price-versus-volume split and sustainability of growth; management gave no split.

watchlist.response: Management said productivity is embedded in operations and it will take a balanced approach, giving no margin number or target.
